notes: Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS; building query/assist features for enterprise customers.
Trial summary: used Hosted API for 2 weeks. Integrated chat & embeddings routes. No PII sent in trial data; synthetic production traces used.
Observed trial metrics (approx): avg qps 4.2, peak qps 18, average concurrent chats ~7 during peak windows.
Token mix (trial): ~68% short chat requests (50-250 tokens), 20% embeddings (single vector up to 512 tokens), 12% reranking/longer prompts (600-2k tokens) — expecting heavier reranking in prod.
Prod forecast (customer-provided): day1 GA: avg qps 8, peak qps 30; steady-state 6-8 qps; expected growth 20% month-over-month first 6 months.
Latency/SLAs: product team targets 200ms/token median for chat path; front-end needs <1.2s end-to-end on typical prompts.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget. Wants tradeoffs: quantized lower-cost model vs. higher-perf instance for latency-sensitive routes.
Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models; want ability to pin model versions and auto-fallback to cheaper variants under load.
Routing/fallback: require region-aware routing (NA primary, EU residency for a subset of customers).
Security asks: SSO/SAML for console, per-account audit logs, KMS-managed keys for encryption at rest, 90-day retention controls configurable.
POC findings: batching improved token cost by ~18% on reranking jobs; KV-prefix caching reduced repeated prefix tokens on support flows.
Quote ask: firm line-item for Dedicated GPU pool (baseline + burst), plus per-token delta for embeddings high-volume jobs.
Customer quote request: include dedicated capacity sizing spreadsheet, breakout of instance types, expected QPS headroom, and failover plan to Hosted API.
SE notes (Priya): need precise concurrency measurements per user session and percent of requests that require full attention (non-cacheable).
AE notes (Jordan): procurement timeline target = Apr 2026; push finance-friendly payment terms (12-month commit preferred).
Customer sentiment: positive on platform performance; cautious on security/residency checklist. CTO quote: "fast, but we need transparency on worst-case costs if traffic spikes."
Open items: final security questionnaire (SEC-7891), KMS integration checklist, and definitive peak token-per-request distribution from prod logs.
